title: End-to-end: a port-PR task completes only after a real evaluator verdict and observed build evidence
outcome: Strict end-to-end acceptance of the P0 outcome on a real port-PR task under an approved pilot policy, with retained evidence for every documented boundary; fixture coverage is not a substitute.
acceptance: A real evaluator run shows pass, failed-build refusal, a non-build natural-language criterion, missing evidence, stale results and evaluator failure on a port-PR task, with evidence retained and the completion seal binding the passing evaluation
Documentation states which modes, hosts and policies were actually exercised
